title: Connection manager: local/remote mode, WG tunnel lifecycle
description: Implement gophermind-osx/connection/manager.go: local mode (connect to localhost, random token), remote mode (establish userspace WG tunnel per backend, route HTTP through tunnel), health checks, reconnection on network change (<5s), connection status reporting. Manage N tunnels simultaneously.
acceptance_criteria: Local mode: connects to localhost:port with random token, health check passes
Remote mode: establishes WG tunnel, routes HTTP through tunnel, health check passes
Multiple tunnels: can manage N backends simultaneously
Reconnection: network change triggers reconnect within 5s
Unit tests: local connect, remote connect, reconnection, multi-tunnel
